news.title: Inside U-M’s rare program to save ancient texts
news.summary_en: Nine scholars recently attended a seminar at the University of Michigan to learn about conserving papyrus manuscripts.
news.author: Mike Householder, Associated Press

news.title: U-M picks Vanderbilt’s C. Cybele Raver as next president: What to know
news.summary_en: The second female president in the university’s history would face numerous challenges, from data center opposition to searching for a new athletic director to navigating a tricky relationship with the federal government.
news.author: Isabel Lohman
